scope: Selected final v80/v83 recipes, historical calibration/configuration, component/evaluation audits, and concise research reports; generated row dumps, plots and operational bookkeeping stay local.
selection_basis: Dependency closure of the active v80 run inputs, selected upstream run metadata, v83 final/release provenance, and referenced validation summaries.
source_retention: All 958 tracked Python files are preserved unchanged to keep the active refit frozen source set valid.
local_file_policy: Untracking only; files are not deleted or rewritten. Training caches and checkpoints remain available.
history_policy: No history rewrite. This changes the main checkout and future tracking, not historical commits.
